subject: general
question: Which of the following forts is located in Tamil Nadu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manora Fort.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Manora fort is located **20 km (12 mi) away from Pattukkottai, Tamil Nadu, India, and 60 km (37 mi) away from Thanjavur**.
 
• It was built **to commemorate the British victory over Napoleon.**
 
• Manora Fort was built by the Talpur dynasty in **1797** in order to protect the port, which holds trade with **Oman and Bahrain.**
 
• The fort was built at the top of cliffs that were **90–100 feet (27–30 m) in height,** with a small mosque and round tower.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60b0cd4b6b089e14f42c390f1f5a1e732db5397f7ae5c0df1e603b02f33b7d5f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sikandra Fort is **the place where the Tomb of the great Mughal Emperor stands**.
 
• Amer Fort is **known for its artistic style elements**.
 
• **Jaisalmer Fort** is located in the city of Jaisalmer, in the **Indian state of Rajasthan.**​
